sources.entry: Offsend - Local-first menu bar app that prepares projects, files, and clipboard text for AI tools by detecting and masking sensitive data.

summary.one_liner: Offsend is a local-first tool that detects secrets in files, repos, and AI-tool context, and replaces them with reversible {{TYPE:v1...}} tokens so AI agents keep working without seeing plaintext.
summary.what_it_does: The CLI installs user-level Cursor and Claude hooks that seal secret-bearing file reads and MCP responses into tokens, and it can restore them with offsend unseal. Per-repo policy lives in a committed .offsend.yml, written by offsend init and applied by offsend sync, covering ignore rules, sealing, policy checks, and git pre-commit and post-merge hooks. offsend check scans files, staged changes, stdin, or editor hook JSON for secrets, and offsend history audit/scrub looks for secrets already in local Cursor and Claude transcripts. A GitHub Action (Offsend/ai-hygiene) can fail pull requests that would expose secrets or ignore drift. The README says scanning runs locally and that no scanned contents, prompts, or findings are uploaded; Check only analyzes a public GitHub repo the user chooses to scan online. A macOS app (Safe Paste, drag-and-drop prep, watched folders) and a browser extension for chat apps are also described.
use_cases: keep AI coding agents from seeing database passwords and API keys
mask secrets before pasting text or files into AI chat tools
add a committed AI-context policy to a team git repository
block pull requests that would leak secrets in CI
find and scrub secrets already stored in local agent transcripts
scan a public GitHub repository for leaked secrets
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <install script URL in README> | bash  (also runs offsend setup)
offsend init --template node  (in a repo you own)
git add .offsend.yml && git commit -m "Add AI context policy"
stack: Rust crates: offsend-detect, offsend-policy, offsend-seal, offsend-ffi
notable: Seals secrets into reversible {{TYPE:v1...}} tokens so the agent keeps working instead of being blocked
Fails closed: without a seal key, secret-bearing MCP output is withheld rather than passed through
Layered model: machine hooks, per-repo .offsend.yml policy, and a GitHub Action for CI
Runs locally with no account required; README says it does not upload scanned content
Merges into existing Cursor/Claude hook configs and leaves foreign hooks such as ggshield in place
caveats: Defense-in-depth only per the README: cloud sessions and editors without these hooks are not covered
Windsurf and Codex are covered only through a repo policy (offsend sync), not through setup
CLI runs on macOS and Linux only; no Windows or Copilot runtime per the README comparison table
MacOS app has Free and Pro tiers (details in docs/macos-app.md, not reproduced in README)
keywords: prevent leaking api keys to ai
